summary: Falsified the v19 corrections pass, re-pointed the stale pins it created, restated item-4 with measurements, added 19 new structural assertions, and wrote docs/audit/v19/REPORT.md (46KB, 11 sections). (1) FALSIFICATION: read all 68 `applied` rows against the artefact itself (git diff vs 54d75a1 + direct node probes + recomputed contrast ratios), covering every critical/major row and well past the 40% spot-check floor. Found 10 findings (FR-01..FR-10), three of them real ledger/code disagreements: FR-01 FAC-BS-007 is recorded APPLIED on nuc-principal-sensory-v but that record still says the bare "AICA" — the replacement text landed on nuc-cochlear-ventral, a record no finding names, whose own clinical text says the lesion is classically AICA and whose bloodSupply says AICA (FR-02, a new internal contradiction); FR-04 FAC-DI-008's "no longer says X" is literally false (the stale sentence survives quoted in the user-visible contextNote); FR-05 rob-023 clamps only the range, so an in-range inverted window pair still reaches windowMap's wMax>wMin fallback; FR-06 ux-009's tablist still owns a non-tab child and the panel has no aria-labelledby; FR-07 ux-026's new boot help names a control that does not exist ('Cerebral vasculature' vs the shipped 'Vasculature'); FR-03 ux-023 leaked an audit changelog ('v19 (audit ux-023)', verify:anatomy, meshes:false, src paths) into 13 user-visible contextNotes; FR-08 the mirrored-contour fix issues two drawSelectedLabel calls for one selected paired record; FR-09 a dangling JSDoc left by the dc-03 deletion. Every numeric claim in the ledger reproduced exactly from the shipped values (5.88/5.42/6.19; 3.54/3.26; 5.12/4.91; 3.73/3.44/3.93; 2.75/2.53; NUCLEUS_EXPLODE_AU=6; mir-2 origin3d == its own first waypoint; IML has no LINKS body so the midline move is real). (2) GATE RE-POINTS, scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs only, product never bent: the two WCAG 2.5.3 pins re-pointed to the fixed names (violating set now asserted EMPTY; reader changed from 'the violating buttons' to all four module buttons; plus a direct name.startsWith(text) assertion), and the v17 vessel-handoff pin re-pointed to both appended families; both bite-tested in a scratch tree copy (restoring the pre-v19 labels or deleting the vessel append fails them by name). Its stale prose (190 metas/40 courses/77 parts/37 mirrored) corrected to the measured 191/41/79/38 and 103 registry parts. scripts/verify/audit.mjs and checks.mjs were measured FIRST and found already post-v12 (audit.mjs clicks areas-all-on/systems-all-on/data-system-region; .header-presets read only as a must-be-0 count; checks.mjs presetFocusReading reads rowFraming with a vacuous-pass guard; area-toggles §11 reports 0 dead click sites); every inspected check is named in REPORT §6 and neither file was edited. (3) ITEM-4 (plan D2) is CLOSED and gate-protected: verify:area-toggles §10 executes the canvas' own buildLobeLayer over both cortical ribbons and rule == canvas == audit table at y=6/26/30/32 (and y=14/34); the per-plane division sets are pasted in REPORT §7; no product change was needed. (4) NEW CHECKS: audit-facts.mjs groups 13-16 (19 assertions, 49->68 total, 68/68 green) — orphaned-reference sweep over every structured reference and every id-shaped token in the data text with a pinned 5-token prose allowlist; vessel-course first-waypoint-to-parent-body proximity for the 39 JSON + 4 built-in courses (max 56.31 au, the five declared distal MCA branches); kind<->KIND_OPACITY<->MATERIAL_HINTS<->makeAnatomyMaterial<->manifest-hint agreement; and pins for the v19 data corrections (ACoA, thalamogeniculate, AChA territory, syn-claude, two plate frames) plus the merged SceneLayers suppression guard that had no gate. Each bite-tested on a mutated copy via AUDIT_FACTS_ROOT (6 named failures). (5) SWEEP: 29 non-browser commands, 26 exit 0, every tail pasted in REPORT §9. Red: verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit cannot execute at all (spawnSync powershell/node EPERM — the sandbox denies piped child stdio; 0 verdicts; subject matter re-measured with fs: 140 entries / 14,566,178 B / 138 GLBs / 599,204 tris / 0 nrv GLBs), and verify:vessel-render 74/75 because its §3 source pin expects the line dc-01 correctly deleted — that re-point lives in scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs, OUTSIDE this task's exclusive write scope, so it is reported as a handoff with the exact one-line patch and compensated by an in-scope assertion. Browser lanes were not run and are not claimed. Evidence contract verified in the final state: docs/audit/v19/REPORT.md and scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs non-empty; npm run validate, npm run check, npm run verify:pipeline and node scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs all exit 0 (area-toggles 473 assertions passed / 0 failed, up from 469 passed + 3 pinned failures at run start).
